dn7:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
dn7:1.3: tena kho pana samayena dve pabbajitā
dn7:1.4: maṇḍisso ca paribbājako jāliyo ca dārupattikantevāsī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu.
dn7:1.5: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho te dve pabbajitā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
dn7:1.6: “kinnu kho āvuso gotama taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīraṃ? udāhu aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīraṃ?”ti.
dn7:1.7: tena hāvuso suṇātha. sādhukaṃ manasi karotha. bhāsissāmī’ti.
dn7:1.8: ‘evamāvuso’ti kho te dve pabbajitā bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
dn7:2.1: idhāvuso, tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho …pe… [yathā sāmaññaphale evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ]
dn7:2.2: evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu sīlasampanno hoti. kathaṃ ca āvuso, bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro hoti? idhāvuso bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti …pe… evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro hoti. kathaṃ ca āvuso, bhikkhu satisampajaññena samannāgato hoti? idhāvuso bhikkhu abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī hoti. ālokite vilokite …pe… evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu sati sampajaññena samannāgato hoti. kathañca āvuso, bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti? idhāvuso bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti kāyapārihārikena cīvarena …pe… evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti. so iminā ca ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato …pe… parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā, …pe… so abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya …pe… vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodheti. seyyathāpi āvuso, puriso iṇaṃ ādāya kammante payojeyya …pe… seyyathāpi āvuso puriso ābādhiko assa …pe… seyyathāpi āvuso puriso bandhanāgāre baddho assa …pe… seyyathāpi āvuso puriso dāso assa anattādhīno …pe… seyyathāpi āvuso puriso sadhano sabhogo kantāraddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya …pe… ime paṃcanīvaraṇe appahīṇe attani samanupasseyya …pe… so aparena samayena taṃ kantāraṃ nitthareyya …pe… evameva kho bhikkhu ime paṃcanīvaraṇe pahīṇe attani samanupassati …pe…. tassime paṃcanīvaraṇe pahīṇe attani samanupassato …pe… cittaṃ samādhiyati. so vivicceva kāmehi
dn7:2.4: paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. …pe… nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
dn7:2.5: yo nu kho āvuso, evaṃ jānāti evaṃ passati, kallannu kho tassetaṃ vacanāya
dn7:2.6: ‘taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti’vā ‘aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti’vā?ti.
dn7:2.7: “yo so āvuso, bhikkhu evaṃ jānāti evaṃ passati, kallaṃ tassetaṃ vacanāya
dn7:2.8: ‘taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti’vā ‘aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti’vā”ti.
dn7:2.9: ahaṃ kho panetaṃ āvuso, evaṃ jānāmi evaṃ passāmi.
dn7:2.11: ‘taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti’vā ‘aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti’vāti. puna caparaṃ āvuso, bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe…
dn7:3.1: dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. …pe… nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa samādhijena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti. yo nu kho āvuso, bhikkhu evaṃ jānāti evaṃ passati, kallaṃ tassetaṃ vacanāya ‘taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti’vā ‘aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti’vā?ti. “yo so āvuso, bhikkhu evaṃ jānāti evaṃ passati, kallaṃ tassetaṃ vacanāya ‘taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti’vā ‘aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti’vā”ti. ahaṃ kho panetaṃ āvuso, evaṃ jānāmi evaṃ passāmi. atha ca panāhaṃ na vadāmi ‘taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti’vā ‘aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti’vāti. puna caparaṃ āvuso, bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā …pe…
dn7:3.2: tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. …pe… nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa nippītikena sukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti. yo nu kho āvuso, bhikkhu evaṃ jānāti evaṃ passati, kallaṃ nu kho tassetaṃ vacanāya ‘taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti’vā ‘aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti’vā?ti. “yo so āvuso, bhikkhu evaṃ jānāti evaṃ passati, kallaṃ tassetaṃ vacanāya ‘taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti’vā ‘aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti’vā”ti. ahaṃ kho panetaṃ āvuso, evaṃ jānāmi evaṃ passāmi. atha ca panāhaṃ na vadāmi ‘taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti’vā ‘aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti’vāti. puna caparaṃ āvuso, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā …pe…
dn7:3.3: catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. …pe… nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
dn7:3.4: yo nu kho āvuso, bhikkhu evaṃ jānāti evaṃ passati, kallaṃ nu kho tassetaṃ vacanāya
dn7:3.5: ‘taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti’vā ‘aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti’vā?ti.

dn7:3.7: ‘taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti’vā ‘aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti’vā”ti.

dn7:3.10: ‘taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti’vā ‘aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti’vāti. puna caparaṃ āvuso, bhikkhu evaṃ samāhite citte …pe…
dn7:4.1: ñāṇadassanāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti. so evaṃ pajānāti ‘ayaṃ kho me kāyo rūpī cātummahābhūtiko …pe… bhedanaviddhaṃsanadhammo. idaṃ ca pana me viññāṇaṃ ettha sitaṃ ettha paṭibaddhanti. seyyathāpi āvuso maṇi veḷuriyo …pe… tatrassa suttaṃ ‘ayaṃ kho maṇi veḷuriyo …pe… tatridaṃ suttaṃ āvutaṃ nīlaṃ vā …pe… paṇḍusuttaṃ vā’ti. evameva kho āvuso bhikkhu evaṃ samāhite citte …pe… ñāṇadassanāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti. so evaṃ pajānāti. ayaṃ kho me kāyo rūpi …pe… idaṃ ca pana me viññāṇaṃ ettha sitaṃ ettha paṭibaddhanti. …pe… [yathā pubbe evaṃ vitthāre tabbaṃ] puna caparaṃ āvuso, …pe… evaṃ samāhite citte …pe… manomayaṃ kāyaṃ abhinimminanāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti …pe… puna caparaṃ āvuso, bhikkhu …pe… evaṃ samāhite citte …pe… iddhividhāya cittaṃ abhinīharati …pe… yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti. …pe… puna caparaṃ āvuso, bhikkhu evaṃ samāhite citte …pe… dibbāya sotadhātuyā …pe… cetopariyañāṇāya …pe… pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇāya …pe… [yathā mahālisutte evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ]. puna caparaṃ āvuso, bhikkhu evaṃ samāhite citte …pe… sattānaṃ cutūpapātañāṇāya cittaṃ abhinīharati …pe… yathā kammūpage satte pajānāti.
dn7:4.2: yo kho āvuso, bhikkhu evaṃ jānāti evaṃ passati, kallaṃ nu kho tassetaṃ vacanāya
dn7:4.3: ‘taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti’vā ‘aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti’vā?”ti.

dn7:4.5: ‘taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti’vā ‘aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti’vā”ti.

dn7:4.8: ‘taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti’vā ‘aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti’vāti. puna caparaṃ āvuso, bhikkhu evaṃ samāhite citte …pe… āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhinīharati abhininnāmeti. so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
dn7:5.1: …pe… khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
dn7:5.2: yo nu kho āvuso, bhikkhu evaṃ jānāti evaṃ passati, kallaṃ nu kho tassetaṃ vacanāya
dn7:5.3: ‘taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti’vā ‘aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti’vā?ti.

dn7:5.5: ‘taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti’vā ‘aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti’vā”ti.
dn7:5.6: ahaṃ kho panetaṃ āvuso, evaṃ jānāmi evaṃ passāmi.
dn7:5.8: ‘taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti’vā ‘aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti’vā’ti.
